help: usage: fleet-switchboard launch [-h] [--agent AGENT] [--dir DIR] [--resume SESSION] [--headless] [--workspace WORKSPACE] [--role ROLE] [--reports-to REPORTS_TO] [--issue ISSUE] [--repo REPO] [--new-workspace LABEL] [--charter CHARTER] [--checkpoint WHEN] [--overdue WHEN] [--brief-file BRIEF_FILE] [--cloud] [--branch BRANCH] [--idle IDLE] [--hard HARD] [--shape SHAPE] name positional arguments: name The agent's fleet name (lower case, digits, - and _) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --agent AGENT The OpenCode agent definition, such as coder --dir DIR The agent's working directory (absolute) --resume SESSION Open a tab on this existing session of NAME instead of creating one (a restart that keeps the conversation) --headless Start the worker with NO terminal: a session in the OpenCode service, the brief sent through the API (about 2 MB instead of a terminal's 200 to 400 MB). Its tools run in the service's environment; opt in --workspace WORKSPACE The herdr workspace for the new tab (default: the workspace of this session, else $HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID) --role ROLE metadata.fleet.role --reports-to REPORTS_TO metadata.fleet.reports_to --issue ISSUE metadata.fleet.issue (owner/repo#N also sets --repo) --repo REPO metadata.fleet.repo, OWNER/REPO: the project the agent works in. Its gh account (config gh_users) is the agent's GH_TOKEN --new-workspace LABEL Create a herdr workspace with this label in --dir (never focused), and launch into it. A --charter whose `workspace:` line differs is refused --charter CHARTER metadata.fleet.charter: an orchestrator's charter issue --checkpoint WHEN Remind the worker to report at this time (30m, or an ISO time with a zone). Default: read from the brief's CHECKPOINT line, if it can be --overdue WHEN Wake --reports-to at this time if the worker has not reported since the launch (60m, or an ISO time with a zone) --brief-file BRIEF_FILE The first prompt: a file, or - for stdin --cloud Run the worker in the cloud (needs --repo and --branch; --dir is its path in the pod) --branch BRANCH With --cloud: the branch the worker starts on --idle IDLE With --cloud: stop after this long idle (default 10m) --hard HARD With --cloud: stop after this long whatever it does (default 2h) --shape SHAPE With --cloud: the pod shape, S or M
